title: The Great Pie Vault
subtitle: A Thanksgiving Math Escape Room
story: Oh no! The Harvest Feast starts at 5:30, and every pie is locked inside the Great Pie Vault.
The vault has five locks. Each lock opens with a secret code word.
Solve every problem, find the letter next to your answer, and write it in the lock's boxes.
Open all five locks, and the first letter of each code word spells the word that opens the vault.

problems.text: Grandma bakes 4 trays of rolls with 6 rolls on each tray. The family eats 9 rolls. How many rolls are left?
There are 36 napkins in equal stacks of 4. The table uses 3 stacks. How many stacks are left?
A farmer fills 5 baskets with 8 apples each. Then he picks 12 more apples. How many apples does he have now?
Mia has 50 cents. She buys 3 corn muffins for 9 cents each. How many cents does she have left?
The town parade had 615 people on Thursday and 289 people on Friday. How many more people came on Thursday?

locks.name: Lock 4: The Oven Timer
locks.skill: Time to the minute and elapsed time

problems.text: The turkey goes in the oven at 10:15 AM and cooks for 3 hours. What time is it ready?
The pies bake from 2:20 to 3:05. How many minutes do they bake?
The family football game starts at 4:40 and lasts 35 minutes. What time does it end?
Setting the table takes 25 minutes. It is done at 5:30. What time did it start?
A pie is cut into 8 equal slices. 3 slices are eaten. What fraction of the pie is left?
Which fraction is equal to 1 whole?
